literal: The benevolence of one who lacks industriousness, like the swordsmanship in the hand of a hermaphrodite, will fail.
translation: The benevolence of one who lacks industriousness will fail, just like the swordsmanship in the hand of a hermaphrodite.
modern: முயற்சி இல்லாதவனுடைய கொடைத்தன்மை, பேடியின் கையில் உள்ள வாளின் வீரம் போல வீணாகும்.
explanation: This couplet highlights that noble intentions are useless without the practical means to execute them. The desire to help others (வேளாண்மை) requires wealth, which can only be earned through hard work and industriousness (தாளாண்மை). If a person lacks this industriousness, their desire to be charitable is compared to a sword in the hand of a hermaphrodite (பேடி கை வாளாண்மை). Just as a sword is useless in the hands of someone who cannot fight, charity is impossible for someone who does not work to acquire the means to give.
